assertions: review records the forthcoming packet's exact path, exact stored-byte SHA-256 and byte length
reviewer independently rehashes the packet before parsing
reviewer is different from the packet producer
review uses only the packet and its expressly sealed inputs
no result from this checklist is treated as acceptance evidence

serialization_contract.storage_bytes: UTF-8 JSON; no BOM; exactly one terminal LF; indentation and stored key order are formatting; file SHA-256 covers every stored byte including the LF
serialization_contract.record_preimage: RFC8785/JCS UTF-8 for the individual record; recursive canonical object-key order; array order preserved; no BOM, indentation, outer-file framing or terminal LF
serialization_contract.separation_assertion: file/storage hashes and record/facet/claim hashes must be explicitly named and must never be compared as if they share a byte domain

assertions: split every retained assertion into atomic claims
map every claim to at least one existing stable locus ID
allow multiple loci but no prose-only or line-range-only surrogate
claim IDs are unique and ordered deterministically by owner then ordinal
recompute every changed claim, facet, dedupe and packet hash

ftc_checklist.assert: Exact recovered producer identity and returned-payload chain are embedded without abbreviation or inference; returned, normalized and stored-byte domains reconcile exactly.
All 6 unique projects serialize IN_PROMPT_UNIQUE_95 membership, occurrence weight 1 each and total weight 6; no project duplication or denominator substitution.
Each project has complete immutable repository identity and required metadata; values are source-bound, not inferred from memory.
Every cited revision is an exact immutable 40-hex commit and every dependent record binds to that revision.
Exactly 25 unique stable loci are serialized; coordinates are bounded, one-based, revision-bound and mechanically resolvable through the sealed chain.
Licence identity and evidence are present per project at the cited revision; missing or ambiguous licence evidence fails that project.
Community/enterprise and other edition boundaries are explicit; excluded edition evidence is not inherited across editions.
Maintenance and project-status claims remain factual, dated and separately sourced; status is not used as behavior proof.
Behavior assertions use source/implementation evidence rather than README or marketing text alone; provenance is retained per assertion.
Every retained assertion is atomized under the claim contract, every atom has a SHA-256 and at least one existing locus, IDs/order are deterministic and unmapped_atoms=0.
Direct, adjacent and excluded classifications exactly match the sealed project boundaries; adjacent evidence is never promoted to direct and exclusions remain exclusions.
For each asserted behavior, entry, actor, permission, Site/scope, source state, transition, mutation/effect, feedback, audit, concurrency and recovery semantics are explicit or marked unknown.
Each claim is no broader than its cited project, revision, edition, object, facet and loci; no project-wide capability is inferred from a local path.
No UI, route, policy name or neighboring guard is treated as proof of an enforced action gate without an exact linked locus.
Lifecycle and confirmation assertions distinguish proposal, confirmation, rejection and completed mutation; labels alone do not prove transitions.
Recovery, replay, history, reactivation and rehire semantics remain distinct; OrangeHRM reactivation is not reclassified as rehire.
Audit/provenance claims state transactional and persistence limits; evidence of logging does not imply immutable history or replay safety.
Visibility and Site scope remain separate from action authority; single-organisation/multiple-Sites semantics are preserved with no tenant claim.
Exactly 12 facet records own exactly 50 expanded facet-locus edges; all joins resolve to existing project/facet/locus IDs and no neighboring facet inherits evidence.
S, S+A and N remain later-comparison vocabulary only; N is not NCM, absence, final no-match, mapping credit or completion credit.
The corrected packet records historical 11/12 linkage and corrected 12/12 linkage as separate states; no history is overwritten and contradictions resolve at the same record/ref.
Unknown, uninspected, bounded-no-candidate, excluded and proven absence are distinct machine-readable states and are not collapsed.

All project, facet and claim hashes recompute under the declared JCS domain; stored-file hash recomputes under storage bytes; FAC-HR-CREATE uses both corrected hashes; dedupe is collision-free; joins resolve; corrected source-facet linkage is exactly 12/12.
Project/facet acceptance, generator readiness, mapping, NCM, completion, runtime, browser, release and all downstream credits remain false in the producer packet and checklist.

required_facet_conditions: project record formally accepted by the later reviewer
facet hash and source-facet hash independently recompute
all locus and claim joins resolve
no FTC defect affecting the facet

decision_rule.GO: Only a different independent reviewer may issue GO after exact-hash review proves every applicable FTC instance, count, hash, join, byte-domain and boundary assertion.
decision_rule.NO_GO: Any mismatch, omission, unresolved join, malformed hash, provenance abbreviation, count drift, boundary promotion, serialization ambiguity or nonzero downstream credit.
